reuse_recommendation: Use the skills with an authorized agent host; adapt the templates and verify current provider contracts before live deployment.
risk_notes: This tree contains instructions and templates, not a hosted runtime. The launch skill calls for owner credentials in local environment/vault storage rather than chat, exposes permission/network decisions and stages write connectors behind explicit configuration. Outbox mocks are not delivered messages; custom-tool mocks block pending a host response and are unsuitable for unattended scheduling. Live launch, spend, network policy and schedule mutations require operator authority in the executing environment. No credentials were supplied, no provider call was made and no deployment or inspected script was run during this census.

It copies ignored environment files into a new worktree and may install dependencies, so worktree isolation does not isolate secrets or make untrusted projects safe to run. The launcher can terminate its session and optional infrastructure; customize and review all commands before running. Host permissions, actual verification results and safe target selection remain integration responsibilities. No source execution, dependency installation, PR creation or license permission was assumed during cataloguing; missing licensing is recorded with reference-only recommendations.
